summary:
I read all 7 files in full and checked every lookup against index.html. Nothing was edited. Every getElementById target exists in index.html except 4. #jmFullCount and #jmFlowCount are missing, but the JS checks `if (fc)` first, so nothing crashes. #todaySection and #cloudToast are created at runtime. site-config.js has no DOM code; it only sets window.ADMIN_UID and window.FIREBASE_CONFIG.

Things the new CSS and markup must keep, or the site breaks:

(1) A global rule `[hidden]{display:none !important}`. Today it only lives in design-system.css:23, which is being deleted. japamala-3d.js:252-259 toggles `hidden` on #jmRudrakshaCanvas and #jmRudrakshaFallback. japamala-3d.css:49 (not being deleted) gives the canvas `display:block`, and that beats the browser's default hidden rule. Without the global rule, a phone with no WebGL shows a blank canvas on top of the fallback message.

(2) Default hidden states, because the JS only adds or removes classes. `.back-btn` must start as display:none. JS writes an inline `display:block` on it (tracking.js:46, japamala.js:59), so don't rely on inline-flex for its layout. `.track-page` and `.japamala-page` start hidden and show with `.active`. `.search-overlay` (this includes #accountOverlay) and `.day-sheet-overlay` start hidden and show with `.active`. `.cloud-toast` shows with `.show`.

(3) `.home-page` must be styled as a flex column. JS sets inline display:none on it (tracking.js:43, japamala.js:55), and goHome in app.js sets inline display:flex to bring it back.

(4) `.jm-stage` must be visible by default. setJmMode (japamala.js:81) switches views by writing inline `style.display` as '' or 'none', so '' falls back to whatever the stylesheet says.

(5) Month swipe geometry. tracking.js:112-117 and :131 work out the month as scrollLeft ÷ clientWidth. So `.month-strip` must be a horizontal flex scroller (overflow-x:auto, scroll-snap x mandatory), with no gap and no side padding. Each `.month-card` must be `flex:0 0 100%`.

(6) Japamala SVG rules:
- Never put a CSS `transform` on `.jm-bead` or `.jm-flowbead`. JS moves them every frame through the SVG transform attribute (japamala.js:152, :274), and a CSS transform would override it and pile every bead in one spot.
- No transitions on them either.
- `.jm-fbead` needs `transform-box:fill-box; transform-origin:center` so the `.pop` animation grows the bead in place.
- `.jm-thread` and `.jm-tassel-thread` have no stroke attributes, so the thread only shows if CSS gives it a stroke (and `fill:none` for the tassel).
- The animations for `.celebrate`, `.pop` and `.jm-confetti` must be defined in CSS. The JS only sets delay and duration on confetti; it never sets the animation name.
- The hidden 0-size `svg.jm-defs` holding the gradients gWood1-3, gMarker, gGuru, gGuruTop, gGold and gFocus must never be display:none.

(7) Every `.cards-section` must stay a direct child of #homePage. weekday.js:108-109 runs `home.insertBefore(sec, home.querySelector('.cards-section'))`. If the sections move into a wrapper, that line throws and stops the rest of the weekday script, so the Firestore weekday map never loads. admin.js:166 also appends new category sections straight to #homePage, and experience.js only tags direct children of #homePage with data-panel (panel="home" for #todaySection).

(8) Built-in cards must keep `.card[data-stotram]` containing an `h3`, `.card-sub` and `.card-desc`. admin.js:145-152 writes admin edits into those elements.

(9) This matters for the new "i" info button and the updates panel. #japamalaPage has `onclick="bumpJapa()"` (index.html:1152), so any tap inside the page counts a bead. A window keydown handler (japamala.js:481-488) also turns Space into a count while the page is open. Any new button inside #japamalaPage must call `event.stopPropagation()`, and even then Space counts a bead instead of pressing the button. Better to put the button outside the page, or handle keyboard for it.

(10) Scroll lock is done with inline `body.style.overflow` ('hidden' or ''), so the new CSS must not force overflow on body.

(11) Bug that already exists: tracking.js:216 `bumpJapa(i, delta)` is overwritten by japamala.js:306 `bumpJapa()`, which loads later (index.html:1320 vs 1323). So the ＋ and − buttons on day-sheet japa rows (tracking.js:170, :172) actually add 1 to the japamala total. Both buttons add, and the row's own count never changes. japamala.js:335 shows the same name clash was avoided for resetJapa but missed for bumpJapa. Suggested fix: rename tracking's version, e.g. bumpDayJapa.

(12) Small escaping gaps:
- The japa name `j.name` from prompt() is put into HTML without escaping (tracking.js:163).
- In the add-chip onclick (tracking.js:179), only single quotes are escaped, so a title with `"` or `&` breaks it.
- `cfg.__icon` is not escaped (weekday.js:122, admin.js:184).

(13) If the Firebase SDK fails to load, cloud.js stops at :15-18 and #cloudAuthBox stays empty. Putting a default message inside it in the HTML is safe, because the script replaces the box's contents when it runs.

Outside the 7 files, these depend on classes that app.js owns: siteConfirm (`.sc-overlay` / `.sc-box` / `.sc-msg` / `.sc-actions` / `.sc-btn.primary` / `.sc-btn.danger`, shown with `.show`), and showDueReminders (#reminderBanner with `.show` and `.rb-close`). library.js reuses `.today-strip` / `.today-tile` for favourites, where the tile is an `<a>` with plain text instead of a button with two spans, so `.today-tile` has to work for both.

items.detail: saveTrack() calls window.__cloudSync() if set (registered by cloud.js:40).

setTrack(): checks #trackPage.classList.contains('active'). If true, calls buildMonths/renderMonths/renderMokkulu/showDueReminders. Then calls renderHomePradakshina() and renderCount() (from japamala.js), which need #homePradakshinaCount and #jmCount.

openTrack() (inline onclick at index.html:592): calls Japamala3D.hide(); sets #homePage.style.display='none'; removes .active from #readerPage; adds .active to #trackPage; sets #backBtn.style.display='block'; removes .active from #japamalaPage; calls stopReaderPositionTracking(), buildMonths/renderMonths/renderMokkulu/showDueReminders; then window.scrollTo smooth.

Inline display writes: #homePage display:none; #backBtn display:block. CSS must make .back-btn display:none by default (styles.css:140 does today) and keep .home-page as a flex column (goHome sets display:flex).

openAccount() (index.html:548) adds .active to #accountOverlay (class .search-overlay) and sets body.style.overflow='hidden'. closeAccountOverlay() (index.html:1065; also Escape via app.js:290) removes .active and sets body.style.overflow=''.

initHomePradakshina() (called from app.js:524) sets #homeDatePicker.value if it is empty; renderHomePradakshina() sets #homePradakshinaCount textContent. onHomeDateChange (index.html:601) and bumpHomePradakshina (index.html:606/611) re-render the count.

initStotramCounter() (called from app.js:80) sets #stotramDatePicker.value to today and #stotramCounterLabel textContent to '{title} — పారాయణం'. renderStotramCounter() sets #stotramParayanaCount. Inline handlers: onStotramDateChange (1014), bumpStotramParayana (1019/1024).

The reset functions (resetHomePradakshina index.html:602, resetStotramParayana 1015, resetDayPradakshina, resetJapa) await siteConfirm(msg, {okLabel:'రీసెట్ / Reset', danger:true}). siteConfirm is defined in app.js:220 and builds .sc-overlay > .sc-box[role=dialog] > .sc-msg + .sc-actions > .sc-btn[data-no] + .sc-btn.danger/.primary[data-yes], shown with .sc-overlay.show. The message contains \n newlines, so .sc-msg needs white-space:pre-line.
Calls showDueReminders() from app.js:275. It writes #reminderBanner.innerHTML as 🔔…text…✕ and toggles #reminderBanner.show.

openJapamala() (index.html:591): removes .active from #searchOverlay and #daySheetOverlay; sets body.style.overflow=''; sets #homePage display:none; removes .active from #readerPage and #trackPage; adds .active to #japamalaPage; sets #backBtn display:block; builds all three SVG looks; calls setJmMode(saved) and renderCount(); then scrolls smoothly to the top.

setJmMode(mode) (index.html:1155-1158; the stored mode lives in localStorage 'jm_mode_v2'): sets inline style.display to '' on the chosen stage and 'none' on the others among #jmStageStrand, #jmStageFull, #jmStageFlow and #jmStageRudraksha3d, so the .jm-stage stylesheet display must be the visible value. Toggles .active on every .jm-mode-btn where data-mode equals the mode. Calls Japamala3D.hide() for the non-3D looks and Japamala3D.show(total) for the 3D look.

buildJapamala(): adds 108 SVG <g class="jm-bead"> into #jmBeads. Each holds <circle r fill="url(#gMarker|gWood1-3)" stroke=rgba(30,15,5,.35)> plus a highlight <ellipse>. #jmGuru.innerHTML draws the guru bead: circles filled url(#gGuru)/url(#gGuruTop), <path class="jm-tassel-cap" fill=url(#gGuruTop)>, 7 x <path class="jm-tassel-thread"> with no stroke or fill attributes (CSS must give stroke + fill:none), and a knot circle #b8860b.

renderStrand(), run every animation frame: sets style.display 'none' or '' on each .jm-bead (culling beads outside the view), sets the SVG attributes transform='translate() scale() rotate()' and opacity, and toggles .cur on the bead at the focus. Do NOT set a CSS transform or transition on .jm-bead.
renderCount(): sets #jmCount textContent (1-108) and #jmRounds textContent to 'పూర్తయిన మాలలు: N' or '' (reserve min-height so the layout does not jump).

buildFull(): adds 108 <circle class="jm-fbead" cx cy r fill data-base="url(#…)"> into #jmFullBeads, and fills #jmFullGuru.innerHTML with the same guru/tassel markup (.jm-tassel-cap, .jm-tassel-thread).

renderFull(pop): sets the fill attribute to url(#gGold) or data-base; toggles .cur on the current bead. For the pop animation it removes .pop, forces a reflow, then adds .pop again. It needs .jm-fbead {transform-box:fill-box; transform-origin:center} plus a pop @keyframes. It also writes #jmFullCount if present (it is NOT in index.html).

buildFlow(): adds 108 <g class="jm-flowbead"> (bead 0 also gets class 'start') into #jmFlowBeads, each with a circle filled url(#gGold|gMarker|gWood*) and a highlight ellipse. #jmFlowGuru.innerHTML gets the guru/tassel markup.

renderFlow(), run every frame: sets the transform attribute on each .jm-flowbead and toggles .cur on the current bead. No CSS transform or transition on .jm-flowbead. It also writes #jmFlowCount if present (it is NOT in index.html).

Global bumpJapa() is called from the #japamalaPage onclick (index.html:1152, the whole page), the COUNT button (1207), japamala-3d.js:285/298 and the Space key handler. It plays audio, vibrates, and every 108 counts runs jmCelebrate(). It also overrides tracking.js's bumpJapa(i,delta) (see the bug item).
resetJapamala() (index.html:1206) awaits siteConfirm, resets all views and calls Japamala3D.reset(0).

jmCelebrate(): removes .celebrate, forces a reflow and re-adds it on #jmSvgFull, #jmSvgFlow, #jmRudrakshaCanvas or #jmSvg (strand), depending on the mode. Needs .jm-svg.celebrate keyframes (currently styles.css:922) and .jm-rudraksha-canvas.celebrate (japamala-3d.css:60, which stays).

jmConfetti(): appends 60 x <div class="jm-confetti"> to body. It sets style.left (vw), style.background (#ffdf9e, #d9b25a, #b5341f, #f6ead2, #e8c25c), style.animationDelay and style.animationDuration, and removes each piece after 3200ms. CSS must supply position:fixed, top below 0, size, z-index, pointer-events:none, and animation: <fall-keyframes> linear forwards. The JS never sets animation-name.
Window listeners for pointerdown, touchstart and keydown (passive) unlock audio on the first tap. They do not touch the DOM.

Window keydown: Space calls preventDefault() and then bumpJapa() whenever #japamalaPage has .active, even when a button inside the page has focus. Keep this in mind for any new info (i) or updates control on this page.

#japamalaPage onclick="bumpJapa()": any tap anywhere inside the page counts a bead. Existing inner buttons use event.stopPropagation() (1155-1158, 1206-1207), and so must any new 'i' or info button placed inside.

showFallback() and hideFallback() toggle the `hidden` attribute on #jmRudrakshaCanvas and #jmRudrakshaFallback. The new CSS MUST include [hidden]{display:none !important}, because japamala-3d.css:49 sets .jm-rudraksha-canvas {display:block}, which overrides the browser default. Fallback markup (index.html:1197-1201): span 📿, strong, small.

Pointer listeners on the canvas (pointerdown/move/up/cancel/click all call stopPropagation; they use setPointerCapture). Dragging rotates; a tap or the Enter key calls window.bumpJapa(). The canvas needs tabindex=0 (already in HTML) and touch-friendly sizing.

ensureReady() gets #jmRudrakshaCanvas and a WebGL context, and sets canvas.dataset.jm3dBound='1' (data-jm3d-bound). It listens for webglcontextlost (then calls showFallback) and webglcontextrestored, plus window resize.

resizeCanvas() sets the canvas.width and canvas.height attributes from getBoundingClientRect() times devicePixelRatio (capped at 1.5). If the rect is 0x0 nothing renders, so the CSS must give the canvas a real size (for example width:100% plus an aspect-ratio) whenever its stage is shown.
Exposes window.Japamala3D = {show, hide, advance, reset}. Used by japamala.js, by tracking.js openTrack, and by app.js goHome/openReader.

renderToday(): needs #homePage. It creates <div id="todaySection" class="today-section"> and inserts it with home.insertBefore(sec, home.querySelector('.cards-section')). The first .cards-section MUST be a direct child of #homePage, otherwise this throws NotFoundError and stops the script, so loadWeekdayMap and the date-refresh listeners never run. If no stotras match today, the section is removed. experience.js then tags it data-panel="home".

Exposes window.__renderToday (called by admin.js:108). Re-renders on visibilitychange and on a 60s interval when the date changes. Loads the Firestore map config/weekday 400ms after load.

If the Firebase SDK did not load, the script returns early: #cloudAuthBox stays empty, and window.__cloudSync, stotramSignIn and __cloudFeedback are never defined. Put a default message inside #cloudAuthBox in the HTML; the script replaces the box's contents when it does run.
Sets window.__cloudSync = schedulePush when signed in and null when signed out.

toast(msg): creates <div id="cloudToast" class="cloud-toast"> on body once, sets its textContent, adds .show, and removes it after 2200ms. Messages are '☁️ సురక్షితం / Synced' and '⚠️ సింక్ కాలేదు'. CSS needs a fixed bottom-centre toast hidden by default, with an opacity/translate transition on .show. Use a z-index above the sheets and overlays (the old one was 900) and allow for the bottom safe area.
On sign-in error it calls siteAlert() (app.js:266), which uses the same .sc-overlay dialog.
Exposes window.stotramSignIn, window.stotramSignOut and window.__cloudFeedback (used by app.js flushFeedback). Calls flushFeedback 1500ms after load.
Removes every .card.cloud-card before re-rendering cloud stotras.
